summary: Enhance your skills with Accounting & Finance for Non-Financial Professionals Course. Learn essential concepts to boost your career and make informed decisions.
lede: Accounting and finance training for non-accountants helps managers, project leaders, and operational and commercial professionals interpret financial information and contribute to budgets. Participants practise reading financial statements, assessing costs and budget variances, and explaining financial implications to support business decisions, using exercises in ratio analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to interpret financial information, contribute to budgets, and discuss business performance with confidence.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: no formal accounting qualification is needed, but you should have a working familiarity with business reporting, spreadsheets, and basic numeracy. You will benefit most if you already review budgets, cost reports, or performance dashboards in your role. Advanced accounting software is not required. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for practical exercises, and the course can be delivered without coding or programming.
